d:
Indaur ki rahne vali priyanka philhal men bengluru men rahti hai. unki shadi bihar ki rajdhani patna men rahul kumar se huee hai. ve chhath puja karne bihar aaee hai. kahtin hain ki chhath ki bhavna aisi hai jise shabdon men bayan kar pana mushkil hai...chhath ki daiviy bhavna aisi hai ki jikr bhar se rom-rom aanand ki anubhuti se bhar uthta hai.
